rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose military term when the force is specifically the ground branch.

example.jyutping: ngo5 biu2 go1 jap6 zo2 luk6 gwan1

rows.note: Use this for a military force when the surrounding context makes its ground role clear, rather than naming the branch precisely.

example.english: The army of the two countries fought at the border.
example.traditional: 兩國嘅軍隊喺邊境交戰。
example.jyutping: loeng5 gwok3 ge3 gwan1 deoi6 hai2 bin1 ging2 gaau1 zin3

rows.note: Use this colloquial construction before a people noun for a large group working on the same task.

example.english: An army of volunteers helped distribute supplies.
example.traditional: 有一大班義工幫手派物資。
example.jyutping: jau5 jat1 daai6 baan1 ji6 gung1 bong1 sau2 paai3 mat6 zi1

rows.note: Use this construction for a swarm or large group of animals, especially insects.

example.english: There was an army of ants carrying sugar at the park entrance.
example.traditional: 公園門口有一大群螞蟻搬緊糖。
example.jyutping: gung1 jyun4 mun4 hau2 jau5 jat1 daai6 kwan4 maa5 ngai5 bun1 gan2 tong4
